title: Mar bar Yishmael
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin cites him challenging Rav Nachman in the Tefillat HaShachar chapter. Seder HaDorot says, “I did not find him.” Hyman’s friend, the rabbinic scholar who wrote Nachal Eden, suggests that Yuchasin read Mar bar Yishmael where Berakhot 29a has Rabbah bar Shmuel challenging Rav Nachman.

notes.text: The suggested Mar bar Yishmael reading belongs to the author of Nachal Eden, cited here as Hyman’s friend. Berakhot 29a explicitly names Rabbah bar Shmuel as the objector.
